answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and detecting correlated equivocation across identities: if k identities coordinate conflicting votes, the protocol charges an O(k^2) penalty through quadratic slashing, while escrow seizure and asymmetric depreciation create an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss when a swarm is exposed. Thus, splitting stake cannot dilute risk; pigment, nebula, and orchard identities remain economically coupled.
